name: cbeggroup/gettreatmenthelp
description: Search 12,373 SAMHSA-verified addiction treatment and mental health facilities across all 50 US states. Filter by location, treatment type (Inpatient, Detox, IOP, PHP, MAT, Outpatient), and insurance (Medicaid, Medicare, private). Returns real facility names, addresses, phone numbers, and direct links.
